name: upgrade-planner
description: Produce ordered markdown upgrade plan with batches, risk, rollback, and validation gates. Planning only.

inputs.name: remote-collision-report
inputs.description: Markdown from remote-upgrade-tracker or explicit skipped note.

inputs.name: approved-plan
inputs.description: When set, validate and normalize existing plan instead of drafting new.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Scope filter echoed for plan batches.

inputs.name: custom-instructions
inputs.description: User constraints on ordering, pins, or skips.

outputs.name: upgrade-plan
outputs.description: Markdown plan with numbered batches, validation gates, and rollback guidance.
